text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd be able to<n>witness such an
incredible<n>performance up close!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not! You've just gone and filled<n>me with hopes
and dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can gain special skills as long as<n>you work
hard! Nothing's impossible<n>in this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thank you for confirming my<n>convictions!
